jobs.title: Officer Banking Operations Shenzhen
jobs.descriptionText:
GCOO - Asia & Middle East COO
Our GCOO organisation is critical for HSBC. This team partners closely with business teams to drive simplification and deliver exceptional customer outcomes in Asia and the Middle East region which covers 26 markets, 600+ offices and branches, and more than 140,000 employees. By strengthening our control environment and enhancing risk management, we drive operational excellence and enable the bank to deliver focused and sustainable growth in this super-region.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.
In This Role, You Will
Assist to construct and maintain a robust compliance infrastructure for the OPS department. Fulfill internal and external return and reporting requirements accurately and timely. Assist Line Manager to handle regulatory requirements and inspections.
To supervise banking operations efficiently and accurately according to local regulations and internal operational guidelines. Ensure no customer complaint and operational error and maintain high level of service standards.
Take proper action to ensure all account service related instructions are processed within set turnaround time and full adherence to service level agreement. Monitor the accuracy and timeliness of account related regulatory system input to avoid operational error and loss and assist line manager to set up control mechanism within responsible area. Double check system report prepared by operator and monitor day end reconciliation as well as document filing is well conducted.
Monitor irregular/outstanding cases and handle exceptional cases within responsible area to avoid operational risk as well as to ensure no customer complaint.
To supervise daily and monthly returns prepared by operator and forward to relevant party for consolidation and submission. Assist line manager to coordinate the ad hoc regulatory on-site/off-site inspections.
Assist line manager to arrange and allocate resources in banking operations to achieve maximum performance.
Take up backup tasks for other operations roles as assigned by line manager when necessary and work with team spirit.
To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:
Bachelor degree or above, 2-3 year’s working experience in banking field is preferable.
Be proficient to maintain solid banking operations related knowledge as well as the being familiar with the local regulations.
Demonstrate proactive attitude and able to work under pressure and have a ability to solve the problem with efficiency and meticulous to details.
Self-disciplined, motivated and well-organized, being able to work under pressure.
Good interpersonal skills and coordination skills, demonstrating strong capability on task/people management.
Demonstrating strong team-work sprite, being flexible to mobilize-working per resource arrangement
You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

jobs.title: Universal Banker
jobs.descriptionText:
HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)
Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.
In This Role, You Will
Manage counter operations to ensure compliance with regulation and internal procedures
Maintain counter transaction standards and efficiency
Assist Branch OPP DM on counter related matters
Deliver quality customer service with continuous improvement and minimum complaints
Enhance service & sales culture among Counter Services Team
Achieve Premier/Advance customer number with quality referrals
Develop a well-trained and motivated counter team
Establish a database of all job-related knowledge and regulation
Guide counter team members through further career development
Protect the bank’s interest and provide overall administrative support to sub-branch
Be suspicious of money laundry activities and act accordingly on prevention or remedy
To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:
Bachelor's degree;(recognized by the state)
Good command of English and Chinese;
Be meticulous and detail-oriented;
Be able to work efficiently and willing to take stable but routine job;
With good communication skill
You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

jobs.title: Corporate Banking Manager
jobs.descriptionText:
Corporate and Institutional Banking (CIB)
HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking is a markets-led, financing-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. Through our international network, we connect emerging and mature markets, covering key growth areas. We partner with our corporate, government and institutional clients to help them achieve consistent, long-term performance. Our products and services include advisory, financing, prime services, research and analysis, securities services, trading and sales and transaction banking.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.
In This Role, You Will
To maximize the revenues of customer portfolio and increase the Bank's share of customer wallets
To maintain a high level of credit quality in the jobholder's customer portfolio and to mitigate the hidden risks of the evolving Banking products
To build effective customer relationships and to become the customers' preferred financial partner and trusted advisor.
To coordinate the Customer Service Team (CST) to ensure the clients' needs are covered in a proactive and efficient manner.
To be conversant with the global/local economies and able to respond to business opportunity faster than the Bank's competitors.
To be capable of discussing confidently and professionally with clients, a wide range of bank products which cover capital market, derivative products, M&A, global cash management, structured trade finance, insurance and asset management, etc.
To keep abreast of the trend and development of the sector/industries.
To preserve HSBC's reputation by strictly complying with the increasingly stringent external regulatory requirements.
To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:
Ability to provide marketing support to senior relationship managers
Ability to establish rapport with members of client's management team
Ability to provide good analytical support to senior relationship managers
Strong PC skills (excel, PowerPoint etc.)
Good team player
Knowledge of HSBC Group structures and products
Good verbal and written communication skills
Knowledge of the spectrum of banking products and services
Understanding of risk management and credit mitigants
Good level of financial analysis ability
You’ll achieve more at HSBC.
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
Issued by HSBC Bank (China) Company Limited

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Officer (Corporate Actions).
Principal responsibilities
Provide operational and services support for corporate action events processing
Perform processing and posting of all corporate action events accurately and within restricted timelines
Manage client instructions and captured appropriately within the preset deadline
Prepare all instructions within custodian deadline time, funding or system cut off time
Assist to reconcile outstanding items as guided by the supervisors
Follow up closely on outstanding cases and discrepancies
Complete daily control sheets and report exceptional cases by end of each business day
Update and complete corporate action blotters before day end
Handle business partners’ inquiries promptly within reasonable time

Report exception and irregularities promptly for management awareness
Be flexible to perform any assignment/task or ad hoc projects per request

Good knowledge of banking products across different asset classes
Experience in banking or securities operations, preferred experience and knowledge in corporate action in equity, bond, fund or structure product.
Experience in high transaction volume that requires manual processing with narrow processing window
Strong numerical skills and computer knowledge
Good communication and problem solving skills with proficiency in English and working knowledge of Simplified/Traditional Chinese

jobs.title: Relationship Manager HSBC Private Bank
jobs.descriptionText:
Location: Beijing/Shanghai/Guangzhou/Shenzhen/Chengdu/Hangzhou
Global Private Banking & Wealth
International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best-in-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance. HSBC Private Banking helps high net worth and ultra-high net worth clients manage, grow, and preserve their wealth for generations to come. Our network of global experts helps clients access investment opportunities around the world, plan for future with wealth and succession planning, manage their portfolio with tailored solutions, and find the right support for their philanthropy.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.
In This Role, You Will
Establish new private banking relationships and manage existing relationships in order to grow Assets Under Management and Revenue
Monitor clients’ portfolios on a regular basis to identify additional business opportunities and revenue growth potential
Work closely with other HSBC departments, including International Wealth and P remier Banking, Corporate and Institution Banking and Global Banking and Markets, to identify cross-selling opportunities and bring all of HSBC’s relevant products and services to our clients
Leverage HSBC’s channels, network and brand to pursue business development activities with a focus on International Private Wealth clients
Ensure strict compliance with HSBC’s internal control standards, including areas of risk, regulatory compliance and financial crime compliance
Timely implementation of internal and external audit points together with any issues raised by external regulators
To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:
At least 8/10 years ’ relationship management experience, ideally in private banking, commercial banking or investment banking sectors
Proven track record in asset gathering, asset growth and revenue generation
Excellent communication and negotiation skills
Strong focus on client servicing
Excellent understanding of financial markets and wealth management products
Attention to detail and the ability to think creatively to solve problems

jobs.title: Corporate Banking Manager
jobs.descriptionText:
Corporate and Institutional Banking (CIB)
HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking is a markets-led, financing-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. Through our international network, we connect emerging and mature markets, covering key growth areas. We partner with our corporate, government and institutional clients to help them achieve consistent, long-term performance. Our products and services include advisory, financing, prime services, research and analysis, securities services, trading and sales and transaction banking.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.
In This Role, You Will
Business: To maximize the revenues of customer portfolio and increase the Bank's share of customer wallets. To maintain a high level of credit quality in the jobholder's customer portfolio and to mitigate the hidden risks of the evolving Banking products.
Assist Associate Director/ Director To
Co-ordinate origination and execution of in country activities across the spectrum of banking products/service.
Build the Banking franchise value/reputation in the market place.
Drive achievement against targets for revenue generation, product alignment, customer satisfaction and cost containment.
Combine client relationship management with strong risk assessment and management capabilities ensuring the required credit quality & requisite returns on risk.
Identify event driven opportunities on an opportunistic basis, bringing in sector/country expertise as appropriate.
Aggressively grow HSBC's share of client wallet involving product specialists to ensure product capabilities are in line with client/sector requirements.
By critically assessing the exposures of each customer through vigorous review processes, active communications with Customer Service Team (CST) members and frequent update of market intelligence. Such reviews are to be completed on time as required by the account review cycle and also where deemed necessary.
By working closely with Credit Risk Management to ensure that all credits are in compliance of both internal and external requirements and to formulate / implement exit or rehabilitation strategies for substandard credits. The primary goals are to safeguard the Bank for any material loss and to obtain an optimal balance between risk and return.
Customers and Stakeholders: To build effective customer relationships and to become the customers' preferred financial partner and trusted advisor.
By ensuring customers' experiences with the Bank in all front exceed their expectations, i.e. first class services are provided promptly and professionally; solutions presented are competitive and innovative.
By keeping abreast of the customer's business development through frequent contacts in both official and social occasions.
By providing advisory-led value added services to customers with the jobholder's updated sector knowledge and market intelligence.
To assist senior bankers in ensuring focused relationship building programs are carried out regularly.
Leadership & Teamwork: To coordinate the CST to ensure the clients' needs are covered in a proactive and efficient manner. To support the senior bankers in operational issues.
By effectively utilizing customer relationship management tool (i.e. CME).
By managing client meetings and ensuring that product partners actively participate in discussions concerning client requirements and needs.
By working closely with customers to identify macro operating issues and to satisfy their requirements on a regional /local basis.
Understand and ensure compliance with all relevant internal and external rules, regulations and procedures that apply to the conduct of the business in which the jobholder is involved.
Maintain HSBC internal control standards, including timely implementation of internal and external audit points together with any issues raised by external regulators.
Demonstrate leadership on Regulatory & Compliance matters. Maintain awareness of operational risk and minimize the likelihood of it occurring including its identification, assessment, mitigation and control, loss identification and reporting.
To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:
Ability to provide marketing support to senior relationship managers
Ability to establish rapport with members of client's management team
Ability to provide good analytical support to senior relationship managers
Strong PC skills (excel, PowerPoint etc.)
Good team player
Knowledge of HSBC Group structures and products
Good verbal and written communication skills
Knowledge of the spectrum of banking products and services
Understanding of risk management and credit mitigants
Good level of financial analysis ability
You’ll achieve more at HSBC.
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

jobs.title: Relationship Manager HSBC Private Bank
jobs.descriptionText:
Location: Beijing/Shanghai/Guangzhou/Shenzhen/Chengdu/Hangzhou
Global Private Banking & Wealth
International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best-in-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance. HSBC Private Banking helps high net worth and ultra-high net worth clients manage, grow, and preserve their wealth for generations to come. Our network of global experts helps clients access investment opportunities around the world, plan for future with wealth and succession planning, manage their portfolio with tailored solutions, and find the right support for their philanthropy.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.
In This Role, You Will
Establish new private banking relationships and manage existing relationships in order to grow Assets Under Management and Revenue
Monitor clients’ portfolios on a regular basis to identify additional business opportunities and revenue growth potential
Work closely with other HSBC departments, including International Wealth and P remier Banking, Corporate and Institution Banking and Global Banking and Markets, to identify cross-selling opportunities and bring all of HSBC’s relevant products and services to our clients
Leverage HSBC’s channels, network and brand to pursue business development activities with a focus on International Private Wealth clients
Ensure strict compliance with HSBC’s internal control standards, including areas of risk, regulatory compliance and financial crime compliance
Timely implementation of internal and external audit points together with any issues raised by external regulators
To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:
At least 8/10 years ’ relationship management experience, ideally in private banking, commercial banking or investment banking sectors
Proven track record in asset gathering, asset growth and revenue generation
Excellent communication and negotiation skills
Strong focus on client servicing
Excellent understanding of financial markets and wealth management products
Attention to detail and the ability to think creatively to solve problems

jobs.descriptionText:
Some careers have more impact than others.
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Customer Relations Manager.
Principal responsibilities
Handle escalated complaints from various channels via an end-to-end process from complaint classification, review, investigation, resolution recommended to communications with customers concerned.
Resolve customer complaints and build customer loyalty to ensure relationship retention and uphold the Bank integrity and good reputation
Maintain service excellence and effectiveness in interacting with customers in a professional manner including verbal and written communications
Ensure the complaint handling meeting the internal quality and control standards plus regulatory requirements
Leverage AI Technology to optimize the complaint handling process and support the execution of a range of complaint-related tasks.
Collect and report on customer pain points and recommend customer journey enhancements to uplift customer experience and preempt customer complaints
Share best practices of complaint handling with other customers facing colleagues
Undertake speedy actions to minimize impacts of incidents affecting respective daily operations and business activities
Proactively instill HSBC core values and business principles
Requirements
Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, business or related discipline;
University degree in related discipline or relevant experience
Work experience in financial institutions including good exposure to complaint handling tasks and customer-facing experience
Familiar with retail and wealth management products and services plus and related operations preferred
Customer centric mindset, strong business sense plus positive and sincere work attitude
High degree of personal drive and resilience
Excellent written and verbal communication skills including fluent in English, Cantonese, and Putonghua
Candidate with less relevant experience or skills may be offered a lower Global Carrer Band than stated above.

jobs.title: Corporate Banking Manager
jobs.descriptionText:
HSBC
Corporate and Institutional Banking(CIB)
HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking is a markets-led, financing-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. Through our international network, we connect emerging and mature markets, covering key growth areas. We partner with our corporate, government and institutional clients to help them achieve consistent, long-term performance. Our products and services include advisory, financing, prime services, research and analysis, securities services, trading and sales and transaction banking.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.
In This Role, You Will
Business: To maximize the revenues of customer portfolio and increase the Bank's share of customer wallets. To maintain a high level of credit quality in the jobholder's customer portfolio and to mitigate the hidden risks of the evolving Banking products.
Assist Associate Director/ Director To
Co-ordinate origination and execution of in country activities across the spectrum of banking products/service.
Build the Banking franchise value/reputation in the market place.
Drive achievement against targets for revenue generation, product alignment, customer satisfaction and cost containment.
Combine client relationship management with strong risk assessment and management capabilities ensuring the required credit quality & requisite returns on risk.
Identify event driven opportunities on an opportunistic basis, bringing in sector/country expertise as appropriate.
Aggressively grow HSBC's share of client wallet involving product specialists to ensure product capabilities are in line with client/sector requirements.
By critically assessing the exposures of each customer through vigorous review processes, active communications with CST members and frequent update of market intelligence. Such reviews are to be completed on time as required by the account review cycle and also where deemed necessary.
By working closely with Credit Risk Management to ensure that all credits are in compliance of both internal and external requirements and to formulate / implement exit or rehabilitation strategies for substandard credits. The primary goals are to safeguard the Bank for any material loss and to obtain an optimal balance between risk and return.
Customers and Stakeholders: To build effective customer relationships and to become the customers' preferred financial partner and trusted advisor.
By ensuring customers' experiences with the Bank in all front exceed their expectations, i.e. first class services are provided promptly and professionally; solutions presented are competitive and innovative.
By keeping abreast of the customer's business development through frequent contacts in both official and social occasions.
By providing advisory-led value added services to customers with the jobholder's updated sector knowledge and market intelligence.
To assist senior bankers in ensuring focused relationship building programs are carried out regularly.
Leadership & Teamwork: To coordinate the CST to ensure the clients' needs are covered in a proactive and efficient manner. To support the senior bankers in operational issues.
By effectively utilizing customer relationship management tool (i.e. CME).
By managing client meetings and ensuring that product partners actively participate in discussions concerning client requirements and needs.
By working closely with customers to identify macro operating issues and to satisfy their requirements on a regional /local basis.
Understand and ensure compliance with all relevant internal and external rules, regulations and procedures that apply to the conduct of the business in which the jobholder is involved.
Maintain HSBC internal control standards, including timely implementation of internal and external audit points together with any issues raised by external regulators.
Demonstrate leadership on Regulatory & Compliance matters. Maintain awareness of operational risk and minimize the likelihood of it occurring including its identification, assessment, mitigation and control, loss identification and reporting.
To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:
Ability to provide marketing support to senior relationship managers
Ability to establish rapport with members of client's management team
Ability to provide good analytical support to senior relationship managers
Strong PC skills (excel, PowerPoint etc.)
Good team player
Knowledge of HSBC Group structures and products
Good verbal and written communication skills
Knowledge of the spectrum of banking products and services
Understanding of risk management and credit mitigants
Good level of financial analysis ability

jobs.descriptionText:
Global Private Banking & Wealth
International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best-in-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance. HSBC Private Banking helps high net worth and ultra-high net worth clients manage, grow, and preserve their wealth for generations to come. Our network of global experts helps clients access investment opportunities around the world, plan for future with wealth and succession planning, manage their portfolio with tailored solutions, and find the right support for their philanthropy.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.
In This Role, You Will
Establish new private banking relationships and manage existing relationships in order to grow Assets Under Management and Revenue
Monitor clients’ portfolios on a regular basis to identify additional business opportunities and revenue growth potential
Work closely with other HSBC departments, including International Wealth and Premier Banking, Corporate and Institution Banking and Global Banking and Markets, to identify cross-selling opportunities and bring all of HSBC’s relevant products and services to our clients

Minimize operational losses

At least 8 years’ relationship management experience, ideally in private banking, commercial banking or investment banking sectors

jobs.title: Corporate Banking Manager
jobs.descriptionText:
Corporate and Institutional Banking
HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking is a markets-led, financing-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. Through our international network, we connect emerging and mature markets, covering key growth areas. We partner with our corporate, government and institutional clients to help them achieve consistent, long-term performance. Our products and services include advisory, financing, prime services, research and analysis, securities services, trading and sales and transaction banking.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.
In This Role, You Will
Drive inbound revenue by originating and deepening relationships with multinational corporations investing and expanding into mainland China.
Take end-to-end ownership of the assigned portfolio within the Global Network Banking unit of Corporate & Institutional Banking unit of Corporate & Institutional Banking (CIB) in China. Under the guidance of ling manager, assume responsibility for strategy execution, P&L and balance sheet management, funding, liquidity, risk control, and performance delivery, operating within the Group's defined risk appetite and strategic framework.
Act as the primary liaison for key overseas sites, facilitating the onboarding and banking support for global clients entering the China market. Champion the Global Network Banking proposition by coordinating with international HSBC teams to capture Foreign Direct Investment opportunities.
Formulate and execute business strategies to acquire new-to-bank overseas corporations with presence in China, while broaden existing relationships with multinational subsidiaries in China to ensure sustainable growth and support the Group's ambition to scale the CIB Banking franchise.
Collaborate closely with global/regional/Local product partners and Banking leaders to ensure a coordinated approach in targeting inbound investors, with a clear focus on maximizing business opportunities and returns.
Deliver best-in-class client experience to multinational corporations entering China, ensuring their cross-border banking needs are fully understood and met through strategic and complex financial solutions.
Maintain high-quality credit standards across the portfolio, safeguard the Bank against potential losses, uphold portfolio integrity, ensure full regulatory compliance, and mitigate operational, credit and other risks.
Achieve assigned key performance indicators, including revenue target, profitability, asset and liability balances, and Return on Risk Weighted Assets (RORWA).
Ultimately accountable for the risk profile of the assigned Global Network Banking portfolio, acting as the first line of defend in managing credit, compliance and financial crime risks.
To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:
Proven track record of progressive business development, sales, and credit experience or equivalent.
Extensive knowledge of, and proven business success with, banking products and services. Good knowledge of world class standards across the industry.
Possesses an entrepreneurial spirit and growth mindset; optimises commercial opportunities to enhance value and returns; strong negotiation skills
Strong navigating skills including understanding of the strategic direction, ability of translating strategy into action, aligning and prioritising direction for self and team.
Relationship management experience.
Strong client engagement skills.
Understanding and experience with managing Multinational Corporates.
Strong strategic thinking, and organisational, analytical, negotiation, and influencing skills. A team player.
Excellent spoken and written English skill. Proficient in other languages will be an advantage.
Progressive banking experience, preferably within corporate banking or multinational corporate coverage.
You’ll achieve more at HSBC.
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Leverage HSBC’s channels, network and brand to pursue business development activities with a focus on International Private Wealth clients

HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)
Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth.
Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.
In This Role, You Will
Impact on the Business/Function
Support the achievement of Country AOP
Achieve agreed Key Performance Indicator objectives by development of existing and new relationships
Build effective relationships with clients to retain and develop sustainable relationships
Complete regular reviews with clients to understand their current and long term needs and advice them on the products and services that help them achieve their goals
Effective use of tools and information to drive client service delivery and
WPB performance
Maintain a minimum standard of qualifying Premier clients within portfolio as stated by Group
Build a high personal and corporate profile in the community in which you are based. Develop network of Group and External professional contacts with the aim of introducing new business, enhancing technical knowledge and promoting the brand
Monitor and act on daily sales activity management information and other internal information tools, using them to coach the wider Branch team in support of business goals
Establish and agree client contact strategies in line with Group operating models
Fully utilise and input to Client Relationship Management data, ensuring all client information is complete and kept up to date
Leadership & Teamwork
To work as part of an integrated branch management team to ensure, standards and are met and operating models delivered
Proactively support others through direct and indirect actions beyond activities particular to this role
Collaborate with the wider team to deliver the Branch WPB Performance measures and plan to support the multi channel client journey
Establish and maintain strong working relationships with colleagues in the wider WPB businesses and others as appropriate to service client needs
Customers / Stakeholders
Own the client relationship with HSBC
Maintain a deep understanding and technical knowledge of relevant products and services available from Group sources and elsewhere in order to provide the best solutions for clients and maximise revenues for Global Wealth and the Group
Maintain highest standard of excellence in client service across the team and with individual portfolio - Ongoing analysis of client portfolios through marketing of ideas and researching clients
Monitor client satisfaction data implementing portfolio level improvements
Work with the broader branch, support and direct teams to ensure achievement of the business performance measures by delivering differentiated products and services to the client
Deliver fair outcomes for our customers and ensure own conduct maintains the orderly and transparent operation of financial markets
Operational Effectiveness & Control
Ensuring that sales and operations are undertaken in accordance with HSBC Bank plc FIM, BIM and Credit Policy Manual appropriate lending guidelines
Agree and manage lending facilities within any agreed Approval Authority (RAA)
Manage operational risk, by using relevant Management Information to identify risk situations and take any appropriate action to minimise loss
Adhere to selling process and sales quality requirements
To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:
Attain appropriate professional and regulatory qualifications as required by market
Attain any internal standards as required by country
Knowledge & Experience
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
Minimum of three years proven and progressive financial services and/or retail sales experience or equivalent
Evidence of strong sales results in insurance and investment products
Relationship management experience with high net worth clients
Strong technical skills in wealth management
Strong communication, client focus and influencing skills
Strong sales orientation, networking and portfolio management skills
Sound knowledge of financial services products and services and the client relationship management system
Understanding of business banking client segment and products and services
Local regulatory & license requirements - job holder should possess valid licenses with accreditation on wealth management and qualification as required by HBCN
Clear view on how to work with Compliance, Credit & Risk and Internal Control to ensure a balanced risk operating environment
Able to communicate well in English and local languages
Accreditations
Attain appropriate professional and regulatory qualifications as required by market
Attain any internal standards as required by HBCN

jobs.title: Associate Corporate Banking Manager
jobs.descriptionText:
Corporate and Institutional Banking
HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking is a markets-led, financing-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. Through our international network, we connect emerging and mature markets, covering key growth areas. We partner with our corporate, government and institutional clients to help them achieve consistent, long-term performance. Our products and services include advisory, financing, prime services, research and analysis, securities services, trading and sales and transaction banking.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.
Drive inbound revenue by originating and deepening relationships with multinational corporations investing and expanding into mainland China.
Take end-to-end ownership of the assigned portfolio within the Global Network Banking unit of Corporate & Institutional Banking unit of Corporate & Institutional Banking (CIB) in China. Under the guidance of ling manager, assume responsibility for strategy execution, P&L and balance sheet management, funding, liquidity, risk control, and performance delivery, operating within the Group's defined risk appetite and strategic framework.
Act as the primary liaison for key overseas sites, facilitating the onboarding and banking support for global clients entering the China market. Champion the Global Network Banking proposition by coordinating with international HSBC teams to capture Foreign Direct Investment opportunities.
Formulate and execute business strategies to acquire new-to-bank overseas corporations with presence in China, while broaden existing relationships with multinational subsidiaries in China to ensure sustainable growth and support the Group's ambition to scale the CIB Banking franchise.
Collaborate closely with global/regional/Local product partners and Banking leaders to ensure a coordinated approach in targeting inbound investors, with a clear focus on maximizing business opportunities and returns.
Deliver best-in-class client experience to multinational corporations entering China, ensuring their cross-border banking needs are fully understood and met through strategic and complex financial solutions.
Maintain high-quality credit standards across the portfolio, safeguard the Bank against potential losses, uphold portfolio integrity, ensure full regulatory compliance, and mitigate operational, credit and other risks.
Achieve assigned key performance indicators, including revenue target, profitability, asset and liability balances, and Return on Risk Weighted Assets (RORWA).
Ultimately accountable for the risk profile of the assigned Global Network Banking portfolio, acting as the first line of defend in managing credit, compliance and financial crime risks.
To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:
Proven track record of progressive business development, sales, and credit experience or equivalent.
Extensive knowledge of, and proven business success with, banking products and services. Good knowledge of world class standards across the industry.
Possesses an entrepreneurial spirit and growth mindset; optimises commercial opportunities to enhance value and returns; strong negotiation skills
Strong navigating skills including understanding of the strategic direction, ability of translating strategy into action, aligning and prioritising direction for self and team.
Relationship management experience.
Strong client engagement skills.
Understanding and experience with managing Multinational Corporates.
Strong strategic thinking, and organisational, analytical, negotiation, and influencing skills. A team player.
Excellent spoken and written English skill. Proficient in other languages will be an advantage.
Progressive banking experience, preferably within corporate banking or multinational corporate coverage.
You’ll achieve more at HSBC.
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
Issued by HSBC Bank (China) Company Limited

jobs.title: Consultant Specialist
jobs.descriptionText:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
Consultant Specialist
.
Business: CTO Data Technology
Job ID: 55078
Principal Responsibilities
Incident Resolution and Management:
Mobilize and facilitate service recovery of Major Incidents through technical and business calls.
Communicate impact and recovery progress to stakeholders through agreed communication procedures and platforms.
Troubleshoot and resolve incidents efficiently to minimize service disruption.
Capture detailed records of incident recovery activities, decisions, and timelines.
Problem Management Support:
Support the Problem Management incident review processes to identify root causes and implement corrective actions.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure effective resolution of recurring incidents.
Compliance and Standards:
Ensure compliance with all relevant controls and standards, including the Service Management Standard.
Maintain high data quality in Service Management systems of record.
Service Resilience and Sustainability:
Ensure service resilience, service sustainability, and recovery time objectives are met for all software solutions delivered.
Implement automation solutions to enhance incident response and resolution processes.
Continuous Learning and Expertise:
Keep up-to-date with current tools, technologies, and areas such as cybersecurity and regulations pertaining to data privacy, consent, and data residency.
Share knowledge and best practices with team members to foster a culture of continuous improvement.
Requirements
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
Proven experience in incident and problem management within an IT support environment.
Strong understanding of IT Service Management (ITSM) frameworks and best practices.
Familiarity with automation tools and techniques to improve operational efficiency.
Technical competency in the following technologies:
AWS (Amazon Web Services)
Linux operating systems
Java programming language
MongoDB database management
Kubernetes for container orchestration (IKP)
Kafka for stream processing
CI/CD pipeline orchestration (Jenkins, DevX etc.)
App Dynamics / Splunk for observability, Open Telemetry is a plus
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively engage with stakeholders.
Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Previous experience in HSBC are a plus.
You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.
HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
***Issued By HSBC Software Development (GuangDong) Limited Xian Branch***

jobs.descriptionText:
HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)
Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Private Banking and Insurance.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.
In This Role, You Will
Developing our Premier customer base and establishing long term relationships with an assigned Premier clientele portfolio
Managing the total wealth of your clients by matching our financial and investment product solutions to their financial needs
Promoting our Premier Service to potential customers, exploring their needs and making referrals to other business units where appropriate
Supporting branch improvement initiatives, providing customer feedback of our service and ensuring compliance with audit requirements and quality assurance
To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:
University level education, preferably in finance, business or a related discipline
Experience in client facing environment, with excellent relationship building capability
Strong sales and customer orientation, with good communication and interpersonal skills
High level of customer centricity mindset with dedication to deliver exceptional quality services for customers
Good understanding and strong interest of the financial markets
Mature and independent mindset, able to work effectively under pressure
Strong commercial orientation with acute interpersonal skills
Fluency in Mandarin and English
You’ll achieve more at HSBC.
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. jobs.descriptionText:
Some careers have more impact than others.
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of CLM Analyst.
Principal responsibilities
To guide the RM’s/CSE’s/RO’s in identifying and documenting the information required to satisfy the Bank’s KYC due diligence policies and processes.
Executes and reviews negative media alerts, and performs sanction & PEP screening.
Check/identifies for discrepancies between the information held in the customer’s documentation and profile on the system.
Reviews and validated the quality of the due diligence and Know Your Customer (KYC) information on the bank’s customers, in line with HSBC policies at on boarding and periodic reviews.
Work with the CDD Advisor when additional guidance on CDD policy is required.
Assists with other tasks as required.
Plans and prioritize work appropriately considering its importance and urgency in line with business needs.
Takes responsibility for completing assigned tasks to a high quality standard.
Daily discretion within assigned authority
Requirements
Fulltime Graduation/Post graduation from recognized universities with 2 to 5 years of experience.
Good understanding of operational risk and controls preferably gained through experience in front line and/or risk roles.
Good understanding of the Regulatory environment and Private Banking business is an advantage.
Good execution and solid analytical skills.
Ability to multi-task and prioritize.
Good command of written and spoken Chinese (both Mandarin and Cantonese) and English.

jobs.descriptionText:
International Wealth and Premier Banking
Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening
up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Private Banking and Insurance.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.
In This Role, You Will
Act as a senior subject matter expert in insurance planning, delivering insurance-led wealth and succession solutions to High Net Worth Individuals, with a strong focus on Asian clients, particularly from China.
Provide strategic advice on life insurance, legacy and estate liquidity planning, business succession funding, asset protection, and risk management as part of holistic wealth planning engagements.
Partner closely with Relationship Managers to identify client needs and originate planning opportunities, positioning insurance as a core advisory tool within broader wealth and succession planning discussions.
Design, structure, and implement complex insurance solutions tailored to clients’ personal, family, and business objectives, including intergenerational wealth transfer and long-term legacy planning.
Lead succession planning engagements, facilitating client and family discussions around protection planning, estate equalisation, liquidity needs, and philanthropic objectives.
Work collaboratively with internal partners, underwriting teams, and external specialists to deliver seamless end-to-end insurance advisory and execution.
Monitor wealth planning market developments, regulatory changes, and best practices across relevant jurisdictions, translating insights into compliant and effective client solutions.
Collaborate with Private Banking and Group affiliates to strengthen the Bank’s insurance proposition, support client acquisition, and deepen existing client relationships.
Build and maintain strong relationships with insurers, brokers, and intermediaries across the insurance and wealth planning ecosystem, positioning the Bank as a trusted advisory partner.
To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:
Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in insurance advisory, wealth planning, or private banking, with a strong focus on insurance-led solutions for High Net Worth Individuals.
Proven track record in structuring and delivering complex insurance solutions or legacy planning.
Travelling is required on need basis
Strong interpersonal, advisory, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage senior clients and family members.
Able to work independently with minimal supervision; highly detail-oriented, disciplined, and execution-focused.

jobs.title: Consultant Specialist
jobs.descriptionText:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
Consultant Specialist
.
Business: IWPB Technology
Principal Responsibilities
Work with Product Owners, business users, operations, and technology teams to analyze business needs and translate them into clear requirements, user stories, functional specifications, process flows, and acceptance criteria.
Facilitate requirement walkthroughs, impact assessments, and solution discussions across business, technology, testing, risk, and control stakeholders.
Support Core Banking and Payments delivery by clarifying scope, managing requirement traceability, analyzing dependencies, resolving requirement queries, and ensuring delivery teams have a shared understanding of expected outcomes.
Partner with architects, developers, QA, DevOps, and support teams to ensure solutions are feasible, supportable, scalable, and aligned with operational and control expectations.
Support SIT, UAT, regression testing, defect triage, release readiness, operational handover, and post-implementation review to ensure delivered solutions meet business needs.
Proactively identify requirement gaps, process issues, risks, dependencies, and improvement opportunities, and drive timely clarification or resolution.
Maintain high-quality documentation, including BRDs, functional specifications, user stories, process maps, data/interface requirements, decision records, and stakeholder updates.
Act as a trusted Senior Business Analyst for Core Banking and Payments stakeholders, bringing clarity, structure, and delivery focus to complex business and technology change.
Requirements
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Computer Science, IT, Business Information Systems, or a related discipline.
6+ years of experience in business analysis, technology delivery, product analysis, or banking system implementation, preferably in financial services.
Strong knowledge of Core Banking and Payments domains, including business flows, operational processes, system integration, transaction lifecycle, reconciliation, exception handling, and risk/control considerations.
Proven experience translating business needs into BRDs, functional specifications, user stories, process flows, data/interface requirements, acceptance criteria, and impact assessments.
Solid understanding of SDLC, Agile delivery, testing lifecycle, release management, production support, and banking technology governance.
Experience supporting SIT, UAT, regression testing, defect triage, release readiness, operational handover, and post-implementation review.
Strong understanding of system integration, APIs, batch processing, file interfaces, data flows, and upstream/downstream dependencies.
Technical awareness of IBM iSeries/AS400, Java, Python, SQL, APIs, or enterprise banking platforms would be an advantage.
Strong analytical, documentation, stakeholder management, and communication skills, with the ability to bridge business, technology, operations, risk, and senior stakeholders.
Proactive ownership mindset, with the ability to identify gaps, risks, dependencies, control issues, and improvement opportunities early.
You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

jobs.title: Associate, Corporate Sales
jobs.descriptionText:
CIB - Corporate Banking
HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking is a markets-led, financing-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. Corporate Banking provides international financial services solutions that support businesses ranging from mid-market enterprises to large corporates across industries and sectors. Leveraging the strength, scope, and expertise of our global product network, Corporate Banking is positioned as an essential partner to firms seeking to maximise their potential internationally, offering streamlined business access to HSBC’s international network and broad range of market leading banking products and services.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.
In This Role, You Will
Contribute to Global Markets sales revenue generation, return targets set by business performance and objectives
To ensure offering of full range of Markets product suite to corporate clients and to achieve increase in market penetration
To maintain meaningful relationship with clients and explore new customers base for Global Markets in Guangdong Province and nearby areas with quality customer marketing
To synergize the alignment with corporate as well as the teamwork with different product group within Global Markets in optimizing the product delivery
Maintain efficient communication and interaction with Global Markets Trading desk and Transaction Management Services lines in resolving questions and problems of transactions, settlement, booking problems etc. from clients
Identify and keep close updated of regulatory and market risks. Keep the clients and stakeholders up to date with specific news flow and regulatory changes
Support the alignment process with corporate to effectively cross-sell Markets products and solutions
Where applicable, contribute to the successful cross-selling of products of other business units within the Bank
Maintain sound credit quality and in compliance with both internal guidelines and external regulatory requirements.
Demonstrate high professionalism and trustful image in client interaction
Understand, follow and demonstrate full compliance with all relevant internal and external regulations and procedures that apply to the conduct of Global Markets Trading business, also in line with HSBC Code of Conduct
Conduct and support ad hoc projects where applicable
To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:
Bachelor's or equivalent University degree, minimum 5 years' relevant experience in the banking industry.
Well versed with relevant Global Markets products, local regulations, regulatory requirements, market practices and business trends
Experienced in handling and dealing with local commercial banking or corporate clients in China will be preferred
Excellent verbal and written communication skills with very strong people interaction ability
Strong interpersonal skills, open minded, be able to present best-fit solutions for client needs

jobs.title: Investment Counsellor, HSBC Qianhai (GCB 4)
jobs.descriptionText:
HSBC Qianhai
HSBC Qianhai Securities Limited (HSBC Qianhai), a joint venture securities company, was incorporated on 28 August 2017, pursuant to Supplementary Agreement X to the Closer Economic Partnership Arrangements (CEPA) between the mainland and Hong Kong.
The registered capital of HSBC Qianhai is RMB1.8 billion. The Hong Kong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited (HSBC) holds 90% of the shares, while Qianhai Financial Holdings Co., Ltd. (QFH) holds the remaining 10%. Our headquarters are located in Qianhai, Shenzhen. We have branch offices in Beijing and Shanghai, and a trading outlet in Qianhai, Shenzhen.
By combining solid expertise in the domestic capital market with the global competitive advantage of the HSBC Group, we are committed to providing our customers with comprehensive securities services and a diverse range of products, aspiring to be your unique partner in China's onshore capital markets.
Our purpose – ‘Opening up a world of opportunity’ – explains why we exist. For information about our purpose and values, please visit HSBC.com.
HSBC Qianhai is part of one of the world’s largest financial services organisations. Whether you are an experienced professional, looking for your first job, or are interested in one of our student and graduate programmes, we provide many ways for you to develop your skills and achieve your career ambitions in a diverse and inclusive environment.
We offer opportunities across our organisation to build a fulfilling career and work with colleagues and customers around the world. We have roles available in business areas including Investment Banking, Securities Brokerage, Investment Advisory, Securities Proprietary Trading, Asset Management and Private Wealth Management, and Functions, Digital Business Services.
We look for people who are ambitious and want to develop their career and contribute to HSBC’s long-term, sustainable growth. We want employees who can help us achieve our strategy, balance social, environmental and economic considerations and manage risk accordingly.
To ensure we achieve this growth in the right way, we place great emphasis on our values. We are committed to applying the highest standards throughout the company, everywhere we do business.
Diversity and inclusion is at the heart of our business. Joining HSBC will give you the opportunity to work in a collegiate and supportive environment in which we seek to develop and promote you based on merit.
We also have a strong commitment to sustainability and encourage employees to participate in our community projects and other activities.
Job Description
Assess client needs, experience, expectations and risk tolerance.
Develop comprehensive investment strategy and asset allocation proposal appropriate to client.
Coordinate execution of investment strategy with appropriate products and services.
Monitor client portfolios for performance, appropriateness and opportunity
Provide updates on investment opportunities to clients, prospects and Relationship Managers.
Maintain current knowledge of competitor investment capabilities, product offering and pricing policies.
Provide input and support for the development of new business initiatives and product enhancement.
Identify and communicate issues or limitations related to product, platform, operations, systems or pricing.
To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements
:
Proven track record in investment advisory and/or investment sales in private wealth management, asset management, sell side or buy side.
Knowledge of private banking business onshore and/or offshore.
Knowledge of competitive and regulatory environment.
Client focused, with strong sales, analytic, technical, teamwork and relationship building skills.
Strong negotiation, complex problem resolution, communication and presentation skills.
Sound judgment, keen sense of urgency, and high level of professional and personal integrity.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Regulatory Risk and Tax Manager.
Principal responsibilities
The purpose of this role is to oversee key regulatory risk initiatives including the Regulatory Runway, compliance to internal and external policies (e.g. Conflict of Interest, Information Control, etc) and AB&C Compliance across IWPB Asia
Drive the implementation of global policies and procedures across ASP markets (e.g. AB&C, Conflict of Interest (GPAD), Information Control, Volcker, High Risk Role framework etc) and provide advisory guidance/ act as a subject matter expert to markets as needed.
Proactively engage with key stakeholders (e.g. first and second line of defense and Audit) to understand and resolve risks and issues.
Manage the implementation of key de-risking programs and support special BRR projects to mitigate the emerging risks as they arise.
Continue to improve the effectiveness and efficiency on how IWPB manage regulatory risk and controls.
Ensure efficient policy rollout and quality implementation of external regulatory changes in a timely manner by mobilising resources at the regional and market level.
Monitor the current and emerging risk and control environment. Lead risk read across initiatives and provide updates and escalation to senior management as needed.
Interpret regulations and Policy with the support of risk stewards and anticipate key problems and drive solutions. Provide policy related clarifications to markets to enable alignment across the region. Provide feedback to policy owners for possible improvements to policies.
Facilitate the FIM dispensation process by reviewing and recommending appropriate response to Senior Management and obtaining business approval for IWPB markets in the region.
Support the delivery of the Asia Culture and Conduct Programme agenda by driving initiatives and being key contact person for market champions.
Requirements
Experience in regulatory risk and controls; preferable background in Audit, Regulatory Compliance/ Financial Crime Risk or other Business Management roles.
Good analytical skill with ability to understand and interpret complex regulatory requirements and translate into business requirements.
Well-developed leadership skills, not just at a team level but able to engage and drive at all levels, internally and externally.
Good communication skills, with ability to summarise complex topics concisely both verbally and in writing.
Good understanding of the regulatory landscape impacting the banking industry.
Detailed knowledge of how the organisation fits together across Global Businesses and Global Functions, and the ability to mobilise established networks to get things done.
Ability to drive the agenda, influence and communicate at all levels of the organisation.
Good understanding of customer segments/ financial services/ products across the WPB markets is preferable.
Self-starter, comfortable working with concepts, ambiguity and on their own initiative.
Broad experience of major programme or cross market/ region project management.
Candidate with less relevant experience or skills may be offered a lower Global Career Band than stated above.
Due to the urgent hiring need, candidates with immediate right to work locally and no relocation need will be prioritised.
You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

jobs.title: Contact Centre Representative I
jobs.descriptionText:
Please note this job advertisement is only available in Chinese
在这一职位上，您将：
通过电话，电邮以及实时通讯等工具解答客户关于信用卡，一般银行服务，个人网上理财，付款等相关业务的咨询和处理；
发掘客人需求，将合适客户的产品及服务推荐给客人，能够达到预期效果；
根据情况提出合理方案，务求为客户解决疑难，令客户满意，提供高质量服务
任职要求：
良好的客户服务意识并愿意从事客户服务工作；
粤语流利，思路清晰，语言表达能力强，擅于沟通；
良好的团队合作精神；
具备一定的英语沟通及读写能力，能接受轮班安排优先考虑。
汇丰是平等机会雇主，致力构建珍视和尊重所有雇员、重视各种观点的文化。我们在多元共融的环境中促进持续职业发展、弹性工作并提供成长机会，我们对此深感自豪。我们鼓励所有合资格人士提出申请，无论性别或遗传信息、性向、种族、宗教信仰、社会地位、医疗休假需求、政治背景、身体状况、肤色、国籍、服役状况等因素如何，我们都会基于申请人的才能和与职位的匹配程度作出决定。

jobs.title: Sr Customer Development Rep
jobs.descriptionText:
HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)
Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening
up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Private Banking and Insurance.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.
In This Role, You Will
Be responsible for successful implementation of Premier Acquisition strategies
Acquire new-to-bank customers via central or self-generated leads.
In order to deliver a high quality service to our highest value personal clients the role holder will need to complete simple retail sales.
Development of strong working relationships with relevant business areas (e.g., WPB, Marketing, etc)
Delivery high standard customer service to meet customer satisfactory
Qualifications - External
To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
Minimum of one year proven and progressive financial services and/or retail sales experience or equivalent
Sound knowledge of various forms of deposits, WEM product, mortgage, etc.
Knowledge of the constantly changing laws/regulations governing banks/finance industry, consumer trends, competitor offerings, economic and foreign currency markets
Strong presentation and sales skills
Objection handling techniques and work under pressure
Good interpersonal and communication skills
Customer service orientation
Attain appropriate professional and regulatory qualifications as required by market
Attain any internal standards as required by HBCN
You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. jobs.descriptionText:

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Manager, Governance Office.
Principal responsibilities
This key role will support to establish and execute a governance framework that will orchestrate resources and expertise across markets that aligns with business strategy.
The Role Is Responsible For
Designing and implementing robust, risk-based governance frameworks for corridors, ensuring alignment with regulatory expectations across jurisdictions
Managing key stakeholder meetings, including Risk Stewards Forum and risk calibration meetings
Developing and maintaining manuals and risk assessment tools for cross-border risk management.
Ensuring tracking and reporting cross-border MI dashboard into governance forums
Maintaining oversight on key risks impacting business strategy with periodic reviews on external trends and internal control environment
Effective engagement with internal stakeholders across businesses, risk stewards and across markets.
Requirements
Solid experience, exposure and understanding of banking and financial services industry, regulatory and economic environment across mainland China and Hong Kong, with experience in navigating complex compliance environments
Proven ability in working across multi-disciplinary and multi-cultural diverse work environment
Strong business acumen, risk awareness and critical thinking, able to make good judgement that balance customer centricity, business and risk considerations
Self-motivated and proactive with excellent skills in navigating and influencing stakeholders at different levels
Strong project management skills and ability to drive results through others
Fluent in English and Chinese, both written and spoken

jobs.title: Associate, Corporate Sales
jobs.descriptionText:
CIB - Corporate Banking
HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking is a markets-led, financing-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. Corporate Banking provides international financial services solutions that support businesses ranging from mid-market enterprises to large corporates across industries and sectors. Leveraging the strength, scope, and expertise of our global product network, Corporate Banking is positioned as an essential partner to firms seeking to maximise their potential internationally, offering streamlined business access to HSBC’s international network and broad range of market leading banking products and services.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.
In This Role, You Will
Identify sales opportunities that address specific needs for our clients and managing from identification to point of sale and through post trade process
Serve an international portfolio of Strategic and/or Focus multinational clients, including Transactional clients where required.
Manage and develop relationships with transactional clients, including those serviced over e-platforms for flow based business.
Provide day to day sales coverage using the full suite of Corporate Sales offerings and support team members to do the same
Deliver services and solutions that meet client needs and where necessary leverage the bank’s depth of product expertise and Thought Leadership
Develop trusted relationships with clients to drive revenue growth and greater product penetration
Collaborate with other internal stakeholders, including Relationship Managers, Global Payments Solutions (GPS), and Global Trade Solutions (GTS) , to service client needs and improve share of wallet
Drive efficiency and profitability by championing adoption and use of relevant service offerings to meet client needs, for example migrating transactional business to the self-service e-capability, coordinating with Corporate Risk Solutions (CRS) for more complex balance sheet structuring solutions, or identifying further opportunities for the offshore capability to support Corporate Sales
Manage changes to processes as technology platforms evolve
Work with Corporate Sales team to ensure all activities for their set of Strategic and Focus clients are executed in line with their agreed principles
Work through Corporate Sales for ensuring all Global Service Centre outsourced activities are executed in line with the agreed SLA’s and requirements for servicing clients
Identify and originate cross-sell opportunities (cross-border, Corporate Sales /CRS, and cross-selling the Bank)
Where appropriate and responsibility has been assigned, act as Global Sales Captain for specified clients
Grow deep and broad customer relationships to enhance the HSBC franchise and generate value added business
Build and maintain business relationships with clients in assigned area of responsibility
To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:
Bachelor's or equivalent University degree, minimum 5 years' relevant experience as a Global Markets corporate sales
Well versed with Global Markets and relevant Global Markets products, local regulations, regulatory requirements, market practices and business trends
Experienced in handling and dealing with local commercial banking or corporate clients in South China will be preferred
Excellent verbal and written communication skills both in Chinese and English with very strong people interaction ability, Cantonese speaker will be preferred.
Strong interpersonal skills, open minded, be able to present best-fit solutions for client needs
Ability to explore business network, acquire and on-board new client names
Strong sense of operational risk management and ability to adhere to the Bank's operational risk requirements
Attention to detail and ability to ensure that transactions, business information is captured in a timely and highly accurate manner
Able to work independently with limited supervision, proactive and willing to run job duties under pressure against multiple deadlines
Business Travels will be required
You’ll achieve more at HSBC.
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
