jobs.descriptionText:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
Consultant Specialist
.
Business:
CTO Data Technology
Job ID：54484
Principal Responsibilities
Design and Develop ETL Processes:
Lead the design and implementation of ETL processes using all kinds of batch/streaming tools to extract, transform, and load data from various sources into GCP.
Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements and ensure that ETL solutions meet business needs.
Data Pipeline Optimization:
Optimize data pipelines for performance, scalability, and reliability, ensuring efficient data processing workflows.
Monitor and troubleshoot ETL processes, proactively addressing issues and bottlenecks.
Data Integration and Management:
Integrate data from diverse sources, including databases, APIs, and flat files, ensuring data quality and consistency.
Manage and maintain data storage solutions in GCP (e.g., BigQuery, Cloud Storage) to support analytics and reporting.
GCP Dataflow Development:
Write Apache Beam based Dataflow Job for data extraction, transformation, and analysis, ensuring optimal performance and accuracy.
Collaborate with data analysts and data scientists to prepare data for analysis and reporting.
Automation and Monitoring:
Implement automation for ETL workflows using tools like Apache Airflow or Cloud Composer, enhancing efficiency and reducing manual intervention.
Set up monitoring and alerting mechanisms to ensure the health of data pipelines and compliance with SLAs.
Reliability Strategy: Develop and implement strategies to improve the reliability and performance of applications and infrastructure, focusing on service level objectives (SLOs) and service level indicators (SLIs).
Incident Management: Oversee incident response processes, ensuring timely resolution of incidents and minimizing downtime. Conduct post-mortem analyses to identify root causes and implement preventive measures.
Automation and Tooling: Drive the automation of operational tasks and processes, leveraging tools and technologies to enhance efficiency and reduce manual intervention.
Monitoring and Alerting: Establish comprehensive monitoring and alerting systems to proactively identify and address performance issues, ensuring system health and availability.
Documentation: Maintain clear and comprehensive documentation of systems, processes, and procedures to facilitate knowledge sharing and compliance.
Security and Compliance: Ensure that all systems and processes adhere to security best practices and regulatory requirements, collaborating with security teams as needed.
Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities for process improvements and lead initiatives to enhance the overall reliability and performance of systems and services.
Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
Proven experience in designing and managing ETL solutions, including data modeling, data warehousing, and SQL development.
Proven experience in Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, or a related field, with a strong understanding of system architecture and cloud technologies.
Experience of cloud-based solutions, especially in GCP, cloud certified candidate is preferred.
Experience and knowledge of Bigdata data processing in batch mode and streaming mode, proficient in Bigdata eco systems, e.g. Hadoop, HBase, Hive, MapReduce, Kafka, Flink, Spark, etc.
Familiarity with Java & Python for data manipulation on Cloud/Bigdata platform.
Experience with incident management and response, including post-mortem analysis and root cause identification.
Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment.
Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to convey technical concepts to diverse audiences.
Proven experience in AI and machine learning, preferably in the banking or financial services industry
What additional skills will be good to have?
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, CircleCI).
GenAI prompt engineering, Infra as code, containerization and orchestration, IAM, compliance awareness, design for scalability, cost optimization, multi-cloud and hybrid strategies.
Cloud certifications (GCP Professional Data Engineer / Cloud Architect) are a plus.
Experience the IT application controls & compliance requirements
Experience with Vertex AI, model deployment, feature stores, vector search, embeddings.
Experience with streaming (Dataflow/Beam, Kafka) and container platforms (GKE/Cloud Run).
Experience with open-source Iceberg, Trino, etc. and evaluation tooling.
Experience with vibe coding to solve business problem.
/WX

jobs.title: AVP - Data and Analytics
jobs.descriptionText:
Some careers have more impact than others.
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of AVP - Data and Analytics.
Principal responsibilities
Explore, cleanse and transform large volumes of customer, product, channel and interaction data across platforms including GCP and Hadoop.
Develop cross-sell/NBA analytics, including propensity/uplift models, segmentation, eligibility rules and prioritisation logic.
Engineer features from CRM and behavioural signals (e.g., digital journeys, RM activities, campaign responses) to improve model performance and interpretability.
Build and iterate prototypes using Python/SQL and relevant tooling; create decision-ready dashboards and monitoring views in Looker.
Partner with CRM, product and Business stakeholders to define use cases, success metrics and test-and-learn approaches (e.g., A/B testing, champion–challenger).
Communicate modelling approach, assumptions, limitations and outcomes clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
Translate insights into actionable recommendations and implementation-ready artefacts (e.g., scoring outputs, business rules, playbooks, targeting lists).
Drive continuous improvement through automation and modern tooling (including AI/LLM-enabled approaches where appropriate) to streamline analysis and delivery.
Maintain strong engineering discipline (version control, documentation, reproducibility) and contribute to shared code assets.
Requirements
6+ years’ experience in banking analytics/data science, with a structured and well-organised approach to delivery.
Strong understanding of CMB products and operating model, with particular depth in CRM and customer engagement processes.
Advanced Python and SQL skills, with proven experience analysing large datasets and performing complex statistical analysis.
Demonstrated end-to-end delivery experience (development through implementation) in at least one of the following: recommendation/next-best-action, customer propensity modelling, uplift modelling, NLP/NLU, social network analysis, or path analysis (e.g., browsing behaviour or geolocation).
Strong working knowledge of GCP services and analytics tooling; solid understanding of Hadoop concepts and ecosystem.
Proven track record of converting data into insights and delivering measurable business impact (e.g., conversion uplift, increased product penetration, improved RM productivity).
Strong stakeholder management, presentation and communication skills.
Active GitHub contributor (or equivalent evidence of strong version control and collaborative coding practices).
Excellent written and spoken communication skills in English.
Candidate with less relevant experience or skills may be offered a lower Global Career Band than stated above.
Due to the urgent hiring need, candidates with immediate right to work locally and no relocation need will be prioritised.

jobs.title: Insurance ALCM Analyst
jobs.descriptionText:
Some careers have more impact than others.
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Insurance ALCM Analyst.
Principal responsibilities
Business Requirements & Model Specification (IFRS 17 & Capital Forecasting): Own and maintain the actuarial / finance requirements for IFRS 17 financials and capital / solvency forecasting models, ensuring they reflect insurance balance sheet and P&L dynamics. Translate requirements into clear specifications (methodology, calculations, inputs/outputs, controls) for build and change delivery.
IFRS 17 Planning & Forecasting Tool Ownership: Provide SME ownership of the IFRS 17 reporting tools, especially the Planning and Forecasting model, ensuring accuracy, punctuality and fitness-for-purpose of reporting deliverables and Financial Resource Planning processes.
Vulnerability Analysis & Scenario Design: Horizon scan for emerging balance sheet risks, provide timely ALCM / Insurance risk updates to senior management, and partner with Group / central teams to design, expand and validate scenarios reflecting macroeconomic, geopolitical and insurance-specific drivers.
Stress Testing Delivery & Interpretation: Contribute to the design, delivery and governance of end-to-end stress testing and scenario analysis (including global and regulatory exercises), translating scenarios into modelling assumptions and interpreting impacts on capital, profitability and key KPIs. Ensure Group-standard execution across regions and produce MI for Business / Risk / Finance endorsement, with clear documentation of key assumptions and limitations.
Methodology, Assumptions & Expert Judgement: Develop, document and maintain modelling methodologies, key assumptions, limitations and expert judgements; ensure consistency with internal standards and alignment across Finance / Risk / Actuarial. Provide SME input on the Group solutions, processes and controls expectations.
Build, Change & Remediation Governance (incl. UAT): Oversee the model change lifecycle (intake, prioritisation, specification, delivery, testing / UAT, validation and sign-off), ensuring changes are controlled, evidenced, and appropriately communicated. Lead remediation of defects, data issues or methodology gaps to agreed timelines and quality standards.
Model Execution, DQ and Results Validation & Production controls: Run models (or oversee execution) and perform robust data quality checks and results validation, including movement analysis, reasonableness testing and reconciliation to key sources. Execute or oversee required controls across inputs, runs and outputs (incl. run-books, control evidence, issue management), ensuring issues are identified early and resolved with clear ownership and controls meet audit / governance expectations.
Model Risk Governance, Stakeholder Management, MI & Team Support:
Lead engagement with model risk governance / validations activities and coordinate internal / external audit engagement, clearly articulating the control environment and key model risks. Produce timely, accurate and insightful MI and executive / committee materials (e.g., capital coverage, IFRS 17 results and solvency impacts) to support decision-making, and support management of the Guangzhou team to deliver priorities, remove blockers and meet timelines and quality standards. Operate effectively in a culture of constructive challenge, continuous learning and collaboration within the team.
Requirements
Experience
Broad and comprehensive understanding of concepts and principles within multiple disciplines or a fast changing discipline
Business / Commercial knowledge
The role requires a comprehensive understanding of several value units / products / regions / legal entities, alongside an advanced understanding of the industry and the relative positioning of the HSBC's products and services.
Leadership
Management responsibilities for a sizeable team of professionals (including responsibility for budget, and planning)
Problem Solving
Covers a wide range of diverse activities that require complex judgements and solutions based on conceptual thought and strategic vision and analysis
Innovation
Is proactive in developing ideas, continuously searching for improvements in techniques which add value to the business and has full responsibility for implementation.
Accountability / decision making
Latitude to make decisions outside of established procedures but within a policy framework. Broad guidelines are available. Role implements strategy set by others.
Strategic Responsibility
Implements business plans through own team and is accountable for results.
Communication
The role requires an extremely high level of interactive listening, in order to negotiate with others often at the highest level.
The role requires the ability to negotiate and influence within their team with a high level of influence.
Candidate with less relevant experience or skills may be offered a lower Global Career Band than stated above.
Due to the urgent hiring need, candidates with immediate right to work locally and no relocation need will be prioritised.

jobs.title: Premier Relationship Director (Elite RM) 卓越尊尚客户总监
jobs.descriptionText:
HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)
Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Private Banking and Insurance.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.
In This Role, You Will
Developing our Premier Elite customer base and establishing long term relationships with an assigned Premier Elite clientele portfolio
Managing the total wealth of your clients by matching our financial and investment product solutions to their financial needs
Promoting our Premier Elite Service to potential customers, exploring their needs and making referrals to other business units where appropriate
Supporting branch improvement initiatives, providing customer feedback of our service, and ensuring compliance with audit requirements and quality assurance
Premier Relationship Director require exceptional ability to build trusting relationships with existing and potential Premier Elite clients, help clients articulate their needs, and deliver to exceed client expectations.
扩大卓越尊尚客户群，并与卓越尊尚客户建立长期关系
根据卓越尊尚客户的财务需求提供合适的金融及投资产品服务，管理客户的财富
向潜在客户推广卓越理财服务，发掘他们的需求并且在适当的情况下推荐客户至其他业务部门
配合执行分行改进措施，反映客户的意见，并确保符合分行的运作要求和品质保证
卓越尊尚客户总监需要具备与现有客户和潜在客户建立互信的关系，帮助客户表达真实需求，以及帮助客户达成期望的能力
Qualifications
To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:
University level education, preferably in finance, business, or a related discipline
At least 5 years as Relationship Manager.
Experience in client facing environment, with excellent relationship building capability
Strong sales and customer orientation, with good communication and interpersonal skills
High level of customer centricity mindset with dedication to deliver exceptional quality services for customers
Good understanding and strong interest of the financial markets
Mature and independent mindset, able to work effectively under pressure
Strong commercial orientation with acute interpersonal skills
Fluency in Mandarin and English
本科及以上学历，金融、商科或相关学科更佳
至少5年以上客户经理经验
具有前线客户服务经验，善于建立客户关系
具有优秀销售及客户服务技巧，善于沟通及人际交流
以客户为本，致力为客户提供优质服务
了解并对金融市场有浓厚兴趣
成熟独立，能在压力下有良好表现
具有出色商业思维及敏锐人际技巧
普通话及英语流利
我们的福利
汇丰为员工提供全面、贴心的关怀与福利，自入职第一天起，员工就可以在多样化和人性化的工作场所做出积极选择，满足自己多层次的需求。
假期福利
除法定休假外，有年假、带薪病假、志愿者假、妇女节、休假等。您入职后即可享有10~25天的丰厚年假，让您在工作之余有充分的时间放松身心。在您生日当月，更有一天生日假，您可以和家人、朋友等一起庆祝这温馨的时刻。
全面的福利保险计划
包括定期寿险、意外伤亡险、重疾险、补充商业医疗保险等，覆盖全方位生活场景，为您的保障添砖加瓦。
员工体检
每年为您提供一次关爱体检，有多种套餐，全面评估您的身体状况和生活方式，帮助您实现健康生活、快乐工作。
弹性福利
当您考虑为家庭提供更多保障时，My Choice员工弹性福利平台可以满足您不同人生阶段的各种需求。每年您都享有弹性福利积分，可以调整您的福利保险，买卖年假，为家人购买体检套餐等，DIY一份专属于您的福利计划。
心理健康咨询
您和您的直系亲属均可免费获得专业的心理健康咨询，包含个人成长、缓解职场压力、解决情感困惑等，助您一路“升级打怪”，稳步前进。
企业年金
汇丰企业年金这一补充养老金计划为您更添一份保障。建立企业账户和个人账户，由汇丰和您按照一定比例每月缴存。更有专业的金融机构共同运营，确保年金资金的安全独立、灵活投资，您可在退休时领取，提升您退休后的生活品质。
弹性工作
为了让大家发挥最佳表现，您有各种弹性工作的灵活选择。
PSQP专业进修计划
专业进修计划通过为员工报销学费的方式鼓励员工追求职业发展。员工可就经PSQP批核的进修计划和经批核学位列表中涵盖的专业进修享受学费报销

jobs.title: Manager, Business Accounting and Finance Change Analyst
jobs.descriptionText:
Some careers have more impact than others.
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Manager, Business Accounting and Finance Change Analyst.
Principal responsibilities
Actively contribute to new business initiatives and projects, supporting finance system and process evaluations, as well as system testing to ensure robust implementation.
Be involved in rolling out a robust control framework to ensure compliance with prevailing accounting standards and industry regulations and achieve concurrence from external auditors.
Prepare detailed data for regular financial reporting.
Timely response to ad hoc external and internal requests.
Achieve zero material misstatements of financial information reported.
Provide accurate financial information to business in a timely and reliable manner for business analysis.
Able to work closely with other local support functions (finance, operations, risk management and middle office), as well as providing information to regional finance
Build and maintain trust of key stakeholders, including CFO and regional finance team
Able to deliver on agreed objectives satisfying customer’s needs
Assist the business when there is any change of regulations or new business initiatives
Play a key role in Finance Transformation Projects and in-house automation initiatives, driving improvements in operational efficiency and effectiveness across Finance processes.
High awareness of data flows and interface between front office systems and accounting ledgers
Promote process effectiveness for own tasks.
Vigilant monitoring of controls and limits
Establish robust control framework on financial reporting and regulatory reporting, including data control, proper documentation and reconciliation.
Requirements
Minimum of a Bachelor’s degree in accounting or technology and with around 1 years’ experience in financial accounting, financial analysis or management information gained from the China financial market.
Experience in finance transformation projects is preferred.
Technical Skills Sets (both below listed technical know-how are essential for the role): Python (with UI interface), Excel VBA.
Sound knowledge of accounting systems and finance processes is required.
Knowledge of financing products in the securities business area.
Ability to document and communicate concepts, flows, designs in a clear and concise fashion.
Strong business and mind-set together with analytical and problems solving skills.
Well-organized, detail-orientated, able to cope with tight deadlines.
Fluent written and spoken Chinese. Working English required.
Exceptional drive, motivation and commitment and focus on operational excellence.
Candidate with less relevant experience or skills may be offered a lower Global Carrer Band than stated above.
Due to the urgent hiring need, candidates with immediate right to work locally and no relocation need will be prioritised.

Graduate Programme Manager.

Principal Responsibilities
Lead end-to-end delivery of Analyst and Associate programmes, including onboarding, induction, learning, performance reviews, reward, promotion and mobility, ensuring a positive candidate and colleague experience.

jobs.title: Head of Messaging, HK
jobs.descriptionText:
Ready to shape Hong Kong’s enterprise messaging platforms for critical banking services?
Why HSBC
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.
The Role
As Head of Messaging HK you’ll set the strategy and governance for secure scalable enterprise messaging platforms in Hong Kong. These services underpin critical business processes and technology integrations so availability performance compliance and operational resilience are central to success. The role aligns to Group architecture direction and local regulatory expectations while supporting the Hong Kong Technology agenda. You’ll shape outcomes across core banking transformation card platform modernisation and digital platform transformation with a focus on enabling growth in the Non-Resident Chinese (NRC) segment. Success means a clear multi-year roadmap strong engineering practices predictable delivery and sustainable control outcomes.
What You'll Be Doing
Own the Hong Kong messaging platform strategy target architecture and multi-year roadmap including standardisation and simplification
Define approved messaging patterns and reference architectures aligned to business needs and risk appetite
Evolve the platform to meet changing throughput latency data protection and resilience requirements
Deliver end-to-end messaging platform capabilities with production readiness and clear service ownership
Deliver technology simplification to reduce complexity improve maintainability and accelerate time-to-market through standardisation and reuse
Manage delivery governance across multiple workstreams vendors or partners where relevant and cross-boundary teams with clear prioritisation and transparent reporting
Support regulatory engagement and Board-level relationships through clear updates risk positions and delivery confidence
Embed strong engineering practices including DevSecOps automated testing CI/CD and quality gates to increase delivery speed without compromising safety stability or control
Own audit outcomes for the domain ensuring timely remediation and sustainable closure of findings with evidence-based control operation
What we're looking for
Bring proven experience designing and operating enterprise messaging platforms at scale with high availability and strong controls
Demonstrate experience modernising legacy platforms and simplifying complex technology states
Show experience operating at CIO level managing multiple businesses
Apply established experience influencing and managing across a matrix environment including functional management
Use strong governance and execution capability across portfolios balancing regulatory commitments resilience uplift and business growth priorities
Demonstrate experience managing operational financial crime and cyber risk within a regulated environment
Bring experience establishing engineering practices such as DevSecOps automated testing CI/CD and quality gates
Communicate clearly with stakeholders at all levels including senior business counterparts and Board-level forums
Show experience managing cost transparency and improving efficiency through Agile DevOps and innovation
Building Hong Kong’s Messaging Backbone
This role sits at the centre of how HSBC Hong Kong connects systems moves data safely and keeps critical services running. You’ll set direction for platforms that support major transformation programmes while meeting demanding resilience and regulatory expectations. If you want to shape a multi-year roadmap and deliver measurable improvements in stability speed and control this is a chance to make that impact at scale.

.

Key Responsibilities:
Leveraging Strategic Partnerships workstream: Support the programme management of IDP's partnerships workstream feeding the Group AI programme, including maintaining plans, milestones, dependencies, RAID logs and related tracking, and helping ensure deliverables remain aligned to wider programme expectations.
Programme governance and reporting: Support the governance and reporting cycle for the workstream by preparing status updates, coordinating inputs for steering and programme forums, and helping maintain an accurate and timely view of progress, risks and key outcomes.

Special initiatives: Support strategic projects and analyses on behalf of the Director and the wider team, helping frame issues, gather inputs, develop materials and support implementation.
Governance and Committee Memberships
Supports the preparation of agendas, papers and actions for relevant team forums and contributes materials and coordination for Group AI programme governance activities as required.
Leadership & Teamwork
Work collaboratively across partnership, innovation and technology teams in multiple jurisdictions, building strong working relationships and supporting delivery across a matrix environment without direct line management responsibility.
Contribute to team effectiveness by connecting activities across stakeholders, communicating clearly, surfacing issues in a timely manner, and following through on agreed actions and commitments.
Requirements
Programme coordination: Experience supporting complex programmes, projects or workstreams in a large organisation, including planning, dependency tracking, risk management, governance and status reporting.
Strategic analysis: Ability to structure problems, conduct analysis, and contribute to clear, well-supported recommendations for management audiences.
Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience preparing clear materials, updates and presentations for senior stakeholders.
Stakeholder engagement: Good ability to work with a range of stakeholders across business, technology and external partnership environments to support alignment and execution.

jobs.descriptionText:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
Lead Architect
.
Business: CTO Data Technology
Job ID: 53880
Principal Responsibilities
Support a team of Data Architects in designing and implementing data architecture solutions that align with business objectives, technology strategy, and industry best practices.
Help define and communicate the strategic vision for data architecture, considering data governance, data integration, data modelling, and data management. Ensure that the design approaches align with this vision.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand data requirements, translate them into actionable data architecture designs, and influence the development of data solutions.
Ensure data integrity and security by establishing data governance frameworks, data quality standards, and data protection measures.
Drive the adoption of data best practices, data standards, and data management processes across the team.
Provide guidance and mentorship to the team, fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
Stay up to date with emerging data technologies, trends, and industry developments. Evaluate and recommend new tools and methodologies to enhance data architecture capabilities.
Requirements
Leadership: You possess strong leadership skills, enabling you to support and inspire a team of Data Architects. You can effectively communicate the strategic vision and guide the team towards achieving data architecture excellence.
Data Architecture Expertise: You have a deep understanding of data architecture principles, data modelling, data integration, and data management. You can design scalable and efficient data solutions that meet business requirements.
Communication with Impact: Your communication skills are strong, allowing you to effectively convey complex data architecture concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You can influence and align stakeholders towards the defined data architecture strategies.
Consulting: You demonstrate strong consulting skills, leveraging your expertise to provide valuable insights and guidance to cross-functional teams. You can identify opportunities for improvement and drive data architecture excellence.
Relationship/Stakeholder Management: You excel in managing relationships and stakeholders at various levels, establishing trust and collaboration to drive successful outcomes. You can effectively navigate and influence within a complex organisational structure.
Problem Solving: Your problem-solving skills are expert level, enabling you to analyse complex data challenges and develop innovative solutions. You can guide the team in overcoming technical obstacles and making informed decisions.
Data Governance: You have a strong understanding of data governance principles and can establish and enforce data governance frameworks, data quality standards, and data protection measures.
Data Modeling: Expertise in conceptual, logical, and physical data modeling. Familiarity with tools like ERwin, Visual Paradigm, PowerDesigner, or Sparx Enterprise Architect.
Data Warehousing & ETL:Knowledge of data warehouse design. Experience with ETL tools (Informatica, Talend, SSIS) and data integration. Familiarity with Hadoop ecosystem, Spark, Kafka, and cloud data platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).

jobs.title: Consultant Specialist
jobs.descriptionText:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
Consultant Specialist
.
Business: CTO
Job ID
：51994
Principal Responsibilities
Facilitate Agile ceremonies including Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Planning, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Review and Retrospective.
Coach teams on Agile/Scrum principles and continuously improve team maturity and delivery effectiveness.
Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business processes, pain points and strategic priorities.
Conduct analysis and documentation of business requirements, user journeys and system/process impacts.
Translate business requirements into clear user stories, acceptance criteria and functional specifications.
Partner with Product Owner and delivery teams to prioritize backlog items based on business value and dependencies.
Identify delivery risks, impediments and blockers; drive timely resolution and escalation where required.
Support UAT planning, test scenario definition and quality assurance alignment with business expectations.
Track and report sprint and release metrics (velocity, burn-down, cycle time, delivery predictability, quality indicators).
Build and maintain strong communication channels across business and technical teams to ensure transparency and alignment.
Identify opportunities for process optimization and propose practical, data-driven improvements.
Support change management, user enablement and post-implementation adoption activities.
Own end-to-end project management activities including project initiation, planning, execution, monitoring/control and closure.
Define and manage project scope, timeline, milestones, resource plan and budget to ensure on-time and within-budget delivery.
Establish and maintain RAID logs (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies), governance cadence and escalation framework.
Drive cross-team/vendor coordination and dependency management across technology, operations and business units.
Prepare management reporting and steering committee updates on project health, delivery progress and decision points.
Ensure compliance with organizational standards, SDLC controls and audit/regulatory requirements where applicable.
Manage release readiness and implementation planning, including cutover, communication and post-go-live stabilization.
Support benefits tracking and realization against approved business case/objectives.
Knowledge & Experience/Qualifications
University degree or above.
Minimum 10+ years of relevant working experience in technology/digital delivery, including proven experience in Scrum Master, Business Analyst, Project Manager, or hybrid delivery roles.
Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum delivery framework, SDLC and project management methodologies (Agile/Waterfall/Hybrid).
Strong analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication and facilitation skills.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
Experience in requirement elicitation, process mapping, story writing and acceptance criteria definition.
Hands-on experience in project planning, dependency mapping, financial/budget tracking and resource management.
Experience with Agile and collaboration tools (e.g., JIRA, Confluence, Azure DevOps, MS Office, Power BI, MS Project).
High customer-centric mindset with commitment to quality and continuous improvement.
Ability to influence diverse stakeholders and drive outcomes under pressure.
Strong attention to detail with the ability to balance strategic and tactical priorities.
Experience in governance reporting, risk/issue management, and senior stakeholder/SteerCo communication.
Relevant certification(s) such as CSM/PSM, PMI-ACP, CBAP/CCBA, PMP/PRINCE2 would be an advantage.
/51/ZP/WX

jobs.title: Lead Architect
jobs.descriptionText:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
Lead Architect
.
Business: CTO Data Technology
Job ID: 53880
Principal Responsibilities
Support a team of Data Architects in designing and implementing data architecture solutions that align with business objectives, technology strategy, and industry best practices.
Help define and communicate the strategic vision for data architecture, considering data governance, data integration, data modelling, and data management. Ensure that the design approaches align with this vision.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand data requirements, translate them into actionable data architecture designs, and influence the development of data solutions.
Ensure data integrity and security by establishing data governance frameworks, data quality standards, and data protection measures.
Drive the adoption of data best practices, data standards, and data management processes across the team.
Provide guidance and mentorship to the team, fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
Stay up to date with emerging data technologies, trends, and industry developments. Evaluate and recommend new tools and methodologies to enhance data architecture capabilities.
Requirements
Leadership: You possess strong leadership skills, enabling you to support and inspire a team of Data Architects. You can effectively communicate the strategic vision and guide the team towards achieving data architecture excellence.
Data Architecture Expertise: You have a deep understanding of data architecture principles, data modelling, data integration, and data management. You can design scalable and efficient data solutions that meet business requirements.
Communication with Impact: Your communication skills are strong, allowing you to effectively convey complex data architecture concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You can influence and align stakeholders towards the defined data architecture strategies.
Consulting: You demonstrate strong consulting skills, leveraging your expertise to provide valuable insights and guidance to cross-functional teams. You can identify opportunities for improvement and drive data architecture excellence.
Relationship/Stakeholder Management: You excel in managing relationships and stakeholders at various levels, establishing trust and collaboration to drive successful outcomes. You can effectively navigate and influence within a complex organisational structure.
Problem Solving: Your problem-solving skills are expert level, enabling you to analyse complex data challenges and develop innovative solutions. You can guide the team in overcoming technical obstacles and making informed decisions.
Data Governance: You have a strong understanding of data governance principles and can establish and enforce data governance frameworks, data quality standards, and data protection measures.
Data Modeling: Expertise in conceptual, logical, and physical data modeling. Familiarity with tools like ERwin, Visual Paradigm, PowerDesigner, or Sparx Enterprise Architect.
Data Warehousing & ETL:Knowledge of data warehouse design. Experience with ETL tools (Informatica, Talend, SSIS) and data integration. Familiarity with Hadoop ecosystem, Spark, Kafka, and cloud data platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
//WX

jobs.descriptionText:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
Consultant Specialist
.
Business:
CTO Data Technology
Job ID:50271
Principal Responsibilities
Engage with the CIB Chief Data Office (CDO), business users, and relevant subject matter experts to understand, clarify, and prioritise business requirements.
Translate business requirements into deliverable solution approaches, functional requirements, and high-level design documentation.
Contribute to the technical and logical design of key components, producing required design artefacts and interface specifications.
Communicate functional solutions to the development team and provide ongoing support as needed.
Work closely with the production support team to ensure requirements and delivered solutions are well understood and readily supportable.
Promote solution architecture principles, best-practice techniques, standards, and tools.
Provide recommendations and roadmaps for proposed solutions.
Document and share best-practice knowledge for new solutions.
Advocate for process improvements and support the development of solutions.
Provide technical leadership to the team throughout the project lifecycle.
Participate in proof-of-concept (PoC) and technical validation activities to assess feasibility and risks, and recommend suitable approaches.
Participate in design reviews and solution/code walkthroughs, providing constructive feedback and driving issues to closure.
Manage design activities within own scope during agile iterations, delivering in line with product and delivery timelines.
Identify and document key technical risks, dependencies, and technical debt, and drive alignment with stakeholders on remediation plans.
Collaborate with Enterprise, Platform, and other architecture roles to align direction and continuously improve existing solutions within agreed frameworks.
Support delivery coordination activities as required (e.g., requirements clarification, plan alignment, and cross-team communication).
Requirements
Minimum 5 years’ experience working as a Solution Architect within a large organisation.
Strong logical thinking with the ability to abstract architectural patterns from technical solutions.
Strong leadership skills, with the ability to articulate, present, and drive approval of solutions at the appropriate level for both IT and business audiences.
Experience with streaming technologies (Kafka, Flink, Pub/Sub).
Knowledge of database technologies (SQL/NoSQL).
Knowledge of data warehousing and ETL/data integration.
Operating systems and scripting: Linux, shell scripting, PowerShell.
Experience with at least one cloud platform (GCP, Azure, AWS).
Experience with big data platforms (BigQuery, Hadoop, Spark, Databricks).
Experience in data modelling, with a solid understanding of data model design.
Proven analytical skills with the ability to challenge designs and decisions.
Experience managing and resolving complex issues using strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to quickly get up to speed with the current data landscape 5and apply analysis and data skills to new contexts and approaches.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including strong virtual communication (conference calls, video conferencing).
Strong planning, organisation, and time management skills, with a demonstrated ability to meet deadlines.
Self-aware, with the confidence to work independently.
/WX

CTO Data Technology
Principal Responsibilities
Design and deliver CDMS migration and incremental sync solutions: initial full load, CDC cutover, replay/backfill and recovery mechanisms
Develop and maintain batch/stream processing jobs using PySpark / Spark SQL / Structured Streaming (cleansing, standardization, mapping, deduplication and merge)
Integrate with Kafka CDC events: topic/partition/key strategy, handle out-of-order/duplicate/late events, replay, and idempotent processing
Migrate and incrementally ingest MongoDB data: document parsing, schema evolution, nested/array flattening, and mapping to target models

Contribute to engineering excellence: code reviews, standards, documentation, production support and continuous improvement

Strong Python fundamentals and engineering practices; solid hands-on PySpark experience (DataFrames, Spark SQL, RDD, tuning and troubleshooting)

Strong Kafka experience: topic design, partitioning/keying, consumer groups, offset management, replay, ordering and idempotency

jobs.title: Insurance ALCM Manager
jobs.descriptionText:
Some careers have more impact than others.
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Insurance ALCM Analyst.
Principal responsibilities
Business Requirements & Model Specification (IFRS 17 & Capital Forecasting): Own and maintain the actuarial / finance requirements for IFRS 17 financials and capital / solvency forecasting models, ensuring they reflect insurance balance sheet and P&L dynamics. Translate requirements into clear specifications (methodology, calculations, inputs/outputs, controls) for build and change delivery.
IFRS 17 Planning & Forecasting Tool Ownership: Provide SME ownership of the IFRS 17 reporting tools, especially the Planning and Forecasting model, ensuring accuracy, punctuality and fitness-for-purpose of reporting deliverables and Financial Resource Planning processes.
Vulnerability Analysis & Scenario Design: Horizon scan for emerging balance sheet risks, provide timely ALCM / Insurance risk updates to senior management, and partner with Group / central teams to design, expand and validate scenarios reflecting macroeconomic, geopolitical and insurance-specific drivers.
Stress Testing Delivery & Interpretation: Contribute to the design, delivery and governance of end-to-end stress testing and scenario analysis (including global and regulatory exercises), translating scenarios into modelling assumptions and interpreting impacts on capital, profitability and key KPIs. Ensure Group-standard execution across regions and produce MI for Business / Risk / Finance endorsement, with clear documentation of key assumptions and limitations.
Methodology, Assumptions & Expert Judgement: Develop, document and maintain modelling methodologies, key assumptions, limitations and expert judgements; ensure consistency with internal standards and alignment across Finance / Risk / Actuarial. Provide SME input on the Group solutions, processes and controls expectations.
Build, Change & Remediation Governance (incl. UAT): Oversee the model change lifecycle (intake, prioritisation, specification, delivery, testing / UAT, validation and sign-off), ensuring changes are controlled, evidenced, and appropriately communicated. Lead remediation of defects, data issues or methodology gaps to agreed timelines and quality standards.
Model Execution, DQ and Results Validation & Production controls: Run models (or oversee execution) and perform robust data quality checks and results validation, including movement analysis, reasonableness testing and reconciliation to key sources. Execute or oversee required controls across inputs, runs and outputs (incl. run-books, control evidence, issue management), ensuring issues are identified early and resolved with clear ownership and controls meet audit / governance expectations.
Model Risk Governance, Stakeholder Management, MI & Team Support: Lead engagement with model risk governance / validations activities and coordinate internal / external audit engagement, clearly articulating the control environment and key model risks. Produce timely, accurate and insightful MI and executive / committee materials (e.g., capital coverage, IFRS 17 results and solvency impacts) to support decision-making, and support management of the Guangzhou team to deliver priorities, remove blockers and meet timelines and quality standards. Operate effectively in a culture of constructive challenge, continuous learning and collaboration within the team.
Requirements
Experience
Broad and comprehensive understanding of concepts and principles within multiple disciplines or a fast changing discipline
Business / Commercial knowledge
The role requires a comprehensive understanding of several value units / products / regions / legal entities, alongside an advanced understanding of the industry and the relative positioning of the HSBC's products and services
Leadership
Management responsibilities for a sizeable team of professionals (including responsibility for budget, and planning)
Problem Solving
Covers a wide range of diverse activities that require complex judgements and solutions based on conceptual thought and strategic vision and analysis
Innovation
Is proactive in developing ideas, continuously searching for improvements in techniques which add value to the business and has full responsibility for implementation.
Accountability / decision making
Latitude to make decisions outside of established procedures but within a policy framework. Broad guidelines are available. Role implements strategy set by others.
Strategic Responsibility
Implements business plans through own team and is accountable for results.
Communication
The role requires an extremely high level of interactive listening, in order to negotiate with others often at the highest level.
The role requires the ability to negotiate and influence within their team with a high level of influence.
Candidate with less relevant experience or skills may be offered a lower Global Career Band than stated above.
Due to the urgent hiring need, candidates with immediate right to work locally and no relocation need will be prioritised.

We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. jobs.descriptionText:

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of AVP - Data and Analytics
Principal responsibilities
Explore, cleanse and transform large volumes of customer, product, channel and interaction data across platforms including GCP and Hadoop.
Develop cross-sell/NBA analytics, including propensity/uplift models, segmentation, eligibility rules and prioritisation logic.
Engineer features from CRM and behavioural signals (e.g., digital journeys, RM activities, campaign responses) to improve model performance and interpretability.
Build and iterate prototypes using Python/SQL and relevant tooling; create decision-ready dashboards and monitoring views in Looker.
Partner with CRM, product and Business stakeholders to define use cases, success metrics and test-and-learn approaches (e.g., A/B testing, champion–challenger).
Communicate modelling approach, assumptions, limitations and outcomes clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
Translate insights into actionable recommendations and implementation-ready artefacts (e.g., scoring outputs, business rules, playbooks, targeting lists).
Drive continuous improvement through automation and modern tooling (including AI/LLM-enabled approaches where appropriate) to streamline analysis and delivery.
Maintain strong engineering discipline (version control, documentation, reproducibility) and contribute to shared code assets.
Requirements
6+ years’ experience in banking analytics/data science, with a structured and well-organised approach to delivery.
Strong understanding of CMB products and operating model, with particular depth in CRM and customer engagement processes.
Advanced Python and SQL skills, with proven experience analysing large datasets and performing complex statistical analysis.
Demonstrated end-to-end delivery experience (development through implementation) in at least one of the following: recommendation/next-best-action, customer propensity modelling, uplift modelling, NLP/NLU, social network analysis, or path analysis (e.g., browsing behaviour or geolocation).
Strong working knowledge of GCP services and analytics tooling; solid understanding of Hadoop concepts and ecosystem.
Proven track record of converting data into insights and delivering measurable business impact (e.g., conversion uplift, increased product penetration, improved RM productivity).
Strong stakeholder management, presentation and communication skills.
Active GitHub contributor (or equivalent evidence of strong version control and collaborative coding practices).
Excellent written and spoken communication skills in both Mandarin and English.

jobs.title: Asst Customer Development Manager
jobs.descriptionText:
HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)
Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.
In This Role, You Will
To assist Area Manager to lead a customer development team in people management, sales performance management, training and coaching, and operational risk control, so as to maximize the productivity of the team and contribute to the achievement of business strategy with high quality sales and service standard.
Closely monitoring the sales and services quality provided by team members so as to ensure the sales/service process is strictly followed and the delivery of a consistently excellent customer experience.
To ensures fair outcomes for customers are delivered in all situations.
To manage, lead and motivate a team of highly mobile sales staff, and to lead a mobile sales team to focus on activities to expand HSBC’s new to wealth acquisition.
Role success will be achieved by focusing on striving to develop new relationships outside HSBC that will deliver sustainable growth and profitability.
To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:
Proven ability in mobile sales
Current product/market knowledge
Excellent customer service skills
Managerial experience
At least 3 years’ experience in supervisory role of sales function
Excellent interpersonal, leadership and motivation skills
Strong sales and organization ability and problem solving skills
Result driven and able to work under pressure
Good spoken and written English

Senior Consultant Specialist
.
Business: CTO Data Technology
Job ID: 53995
Principal Responsibilities
Design and Develop ETL Processes:
Lead the design and implementation of ETL processes using all kinds of batch/streaming tools to extract, transform, and load data from various sources into GCP, and ETL technologies as Control-M, Datastage, Shell Scripting, Python are an added advantage for cloud migration projects.
Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements and ensure that ETL solutions meet business needs.
Data Pipeline Optimization
Optimize data pipelines for performance, scalability, and reliability, ensuring efficient data processing workflows.
Monitor and troubleshoot ETL processes, proactively addressing issues and bottlenecks.
Data Integration And Management
Integrate data from diverse sources, including databases, APIs, and flat files, ensuring data quality and consistency.
Manage and maintain data storage solutions in GCP (e.g., BigQuery, Cloud Storage) to support analytics and reporting.
GCP Dataflow Development
Write Apache Beam based Dataflow Job for data extraction, transformation, and analysis, ensuring optimal performance and accuracy.
Collaborate with data analysts and data scientists to prepare data for analysis and reporting.
Automation And Monitoring
Implement automation for ETL workflows using tools like Apache Airflow or Cloud Composer, enhancing efficiency and reducing manual intervention.
Set up monitoring and alerting mechanisms to ensure the health of data pipelines and compliance with SLAs.
Data Governance And Security
Apply best practices for data governance, ensuring compliance with industry regulations (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA) and internal policies.
Collaborate with security teams to implement data protection measures and address vulnerabilities.
Requirements
Education:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
Experience
Minimum of 10 years of industry experience in data engineering or ETL development, with a strong focus on Data Stage and GCP.
Proven experience in designing and managing ETL solutions, including data modeling, data warehousing, and SQL development.
Technical Skills
Strong knowledge of GCP services (e.g., BigQuery, Dataflow, Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub) and their application in data engineering.
Experience of cloud-based solutions, especially in GCP, cloud certified candidate is preferred.
Experience and knowledge of Bigdata data processing in batch mode and streaming mode, proficient in Bigdata eco systems, e.g. Hadoop, HBase, Hive, MapReduce, Kafka, Flink, Spark, etc.
Familiarity with Java & Python for data manipulation on Cloud/Bigdata platform.
Analytical Skills
Strong problem-solving skills with a keen attention to detail.
Ability to analyze complex data sets and derive meaningful insights.

HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)
Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.
In This Role, You Will
To assist Area Manager to lead a customer development team in people management, sales performance management, training and coaching, and operational risk control, so as to maximize the productivity of the team and contribute to the achievement of business strategy with high quality sales and service standard.
Closely monitoring the sales and services quality provided by team members so as to ensure the sales/service process is strictly followed and the delivery of a consistently excellent customer experience.
To ensures fair outcomes for customers are delivered in all situations.
To manage, lead and motivate a team of highly mobile sales staff, and to lead a mobile sales team to focus on activities to expand HSBC’s new to wealth acquisition.
Role success will be achieved by focusing on striving to develop new relationships outside HSBC that will deliver sustainable growth and profitability.
To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:
Proven ability in mobile sales
Current product/market knowledge
Excellent customer service skills
Managerial experience
At least 3 years’ experience in supervisory role of sales function
Excellent interpersonal, leadership and motivation skills
Strong sales and organization ability and problem solving skills
Result driven and able to work under pressure
Good spoken and written English

Build and run scalable AI safety testing (e.g., orange teaming, simulation, automated evals) and challenge guardrails, complementing Cyber and Model Risk Management testing.
Translate technical findings into decision-ready business risk assessments (impact/likelihood, acceptance criteria, go/no-go recommendations) and evidence for governance, approvals, and audit.

Strong hands-on knowledge of AI/ML engineering, including GenAI/LLMs and common deployment patterns (APIs, pipelines, MLOps/LLMOps).
Experience embedding guardrails and safety controls throughout model build and release lifecycles.
Practical model evaluation experience across performance, bias/fairness, explainability, and robustness.
Proven AI safety testing capability (red teaming, adversarial testing, scenario-based evaluation).
Solid understanding of AI cyber threats (prompt injection, data leakage, adversarial attacks) and threat modelling; able to partner with Cyber teams to run threat-led testing.
Familiar with risk/governance in regulated environments (MRM and operational risk), including documenting test outcomes and linking them to approval decisions.

.

Job ID: 48883
Principal Responsibilities
Partnering with the GCIO Chief Control Office (GCIO CCO) Function to lead the oversight of the risk and control portfolio related to the services CCO CTO Data Technology provides to the Group
You will be a leader within the GCIO CCO Function that directly supports the Data Tech area of the Chief Technology Office within HSBC
Acting as trusted advisor for senior management by partnering to manage their operational risk i.e., risk assessments, control environment, issues management, audits.
Promoting accountable risk and control decision-making based on quality data and analysis, actively challenging poor, inefficient or excessive controls, related tasks and behaviours.
Providing specialist risk and control knowledge and insights, leading efforts to continuously improve the control environment and monitoring of risk, including behaviours
Advising and designing process and controls in a commercially viable, practical and effective manner.
Identifying trends to anticipate future developments in the risk and control environment.
Influencing and shaping the development and implementation of future-fit risk management and regulatory frameworks.
Providing Senior Management with updates on any relevant changes to policy or projects related to operational risk that have an impact on their area of responsibility.
The role is part of a global team and will be expected to support and collaborate with other team members across multiple regions, as well as manage their portfolio while maintaining an acceptable risk profile.
Facing off to senior management and managing respective portfolios.
Responsible for embedding risk and control management framework, including control monitoring and assurance
Advising and designing process and controls in a commercially viable, practical and effective manner, including driving control sustainability through automation and controls by design.
Managing stakeholders across multi-faceted geographies, businesses and functions.
Presenting and reporting complex risk and control information in ways that are meaningful for different stakeholders .
Applying professional understanding, expertise and judgement to oversee the health of the end-to-end control environment
Leveraging opportunities to implement more automated, effective and cost-efficient controls and measures of effectiveness .
Providing advice, support and challenge to stakeholders to help them understand and manage controls and risks effectively.
Functional Risk & Controls lead for CTO Data Tech.
Analyzing and interpreting risk and control related information to provide insight and improvement with clear and measurable outcomes.
Delivering clear, concise and consumable messages based on good evidence and informed judgement that support risk and control related decision making.
Monitoring and analysing the performance of the control environment to drive more effective design and operation of controls
Lead the CTO Data Tech Risk and Control Forum and other related committees and forums.Support CCO operating model, service catalogue, procedures, and toolkits.
Constructive challenge on control environment and assessment of risk across GCIO. Ensuring lessons learnt in one line of business/impacting incident are properly understood for all GCIO with associated actions implemented in a timely manner.
Embed risk culture and change delivery capability across the GCIO CCO function
Identify trends to anticipate future developments in the risk and control environment. Maintain awareness of relevant changes in regulatory guidance and expectation with key regulators.
Leadership & Team Management.
Previous experience leading teams required with remote team leadership experience preferred.
Models open communication and collaboration across the team and with stakeholders.
Develops and maintains long term relationships with stakeholders internally and externally. Experience of working in a globally dispersed team
Knowledge & Experience/Qualifications
At least 5 years of hands-on experience with data, technology and cyber control capabilities preferably in a data platform environment or as a 1/2/3LOD control management function.
At least 5 years of hands-on experience and subject matter expertise in management of operational risk, non-financial risk and/or technology & cyber risk.
Experience across Data, IT, Operations, Risk Management, and / or Audit roles requiring management of diverse risk types is desirable.
Previous experience of identifying, defining and solving problems that have impact on your work or the wider business.
Financial Services or other highly regulated industry experience/exposure is preferred. Strong communication skills to influence and challenge stakeholders.
Ability to work independently with limited supervision. Ability to present complex issues concisely to senior partners using non-technical language.
Flexible and adaptable, able to handle and prioritise competing demands in a fast-paced environment.
Experience dealing with regulatory bodies and engagement wil. Active industry recognized certificates will be an asset, e.g. CISA, CISSP, CRISC, CCSP etc

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer, HSBC Qianhai (GCB 5)
jobs.descriptionText:
HSBC Qianhai
HSBC Qianhai Securities Limited (HSBC Qianhai), a joint venture securities company, was incorporated on 28 August 2017, pursuant to Supplementary Agreement X to the Closer Economic Partnership Arrangements (CEPA) between the mainland and Hong Kong.
The registered capital of HSBC Qianhai is RMB1.8 billion. The Hong Kong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited (HSBC) holds 90% of the shares, while Qianhai Financial Holdings Co., Ltd. (QFH) holds the remaining 10%. Our headquarters are located in Qianhai, Shenzhen. We have branch offices in Beijing and Shanghai, and a trading outlet in Qianhai, Shenzhen.
By combining solid expertise in the domestic capital market with the global competitive advantage of the HSBC Group, we are committed to providing our customers with comprehensive securities services and a diverse range of products, aspiring to be your unique partner in China's onshore capital markets.
Our purpose – ‘Opening up a world of opportunity’ – explains why we exist. For information about our purpose and values, please visit HSBC.com.
HSBC Qianhai is part of one of the world’s largest financial services organisations. Whether you are an experienced professional, looking for your first job, or are interested in one of our student and graduate programmes, we provide many ways for you to develop your skills and achieve your career ambitions in a diverse and inclusive environment.
We offer opportunities across our organisation to build a fulfilling career and work with colleagues and customers around the world. We have roles available in business areas including Investment Banking, Securities Brokerage, Investment Advisory, Securities Proprietary Trading, Asset Management and Private Wealth Management, and Functions, Digital Business Services.
We look for people who are ambitious and want to develop their career and contribute to HSBC’s long-term, sustainable growth. We want employees who can help us achieve our strategy, balance social, environmental and economic considerations and manage risk accordingly.
To ensure we achieve this growth in the right way, we place great emphasis on our values. We are committed to applying the highest standards throughout the company, everywhere we do business.
Diversity and inclusion is at the heart of our business. Joining HSBC will give you the opportunity to work in a collegiate and supportive environment in which we seek to develop and promote you based on merit.
We also have a strong commitment to sustainability and encourage employees to participate in our community projects and other activities.
Description
l Develop logical and innovative solutions to complex problems;
l Drive business initiatives and translate user requirements into specified IT requirements;
l Work closely with stakeholders, developers, architects and a variety of end users to ensure technical compatibility and user satisfaction;
l Create test scenario’s and test cases in integrated system tests and handle the relevant test case executions;
l Participate in System Integration Test, User Acceptance Test, Production and make sure systems are tested thoroughly according to business requirements;
l Maintain relationships with key stakeholders and business contacts;

HSBC Qianhai

HSBC Qianhai Securities Limited (HSBC Qianhai), a joint venture securities company, was incorporated on 28 August 2017, pursuant to Supplementary Agreement X to the Closer Economic Partnership Arrangements (CEPA) between the mainland and Hong Kong.

The registered capital of HSBC Qianhai is RMB1.8 billion. The Hong Kong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited (HSBC) holds 90% of the shares, while Qianhai Financial Holdings Co., Ltd. (QFH) holds the remaining 10%. Our headquarters are located in Qianhai, Shenzhen. We have branch offices in Beijing and Shanghai, and a trading outlet in Qianhai, Shenzhen.

By combining solid expertise in the domestic capital market with the global competitive advantage of the HSBC Group, we are committed to providing our customers with comprehensive securities services and a diverse range of products, aspiring to be your unique partner in China's onshore capital markets.

Our purpose – ‘Opening up a world of opportunity’ – explains why we exist. For information about our purpose and values, please visit HSBC.com.

HSBC Qianhai is part of one of the world’s largest financial services organisations. Whether you are an experienced professional, looking for your first job, or are interested in one of our student and graduate programmes, we provide many ways for you to develop your skills and achieve your career ambitions in a diverse and inclusive environment.

We offer opportunities across our organisation to build a fulfilling career and work with colleagues and customers around the world. We have roles available in business areas including Investment Banking, Securities Brokerage, Investment Advisory, Securities Proprietary Trading, Asset Management and Private Wealth Management, and Functions, Digital Business Services.

We look for people who are ambitious and want to develop their career and contribute to HSBC’s long-term, sustainable growth. We want employees who can help us achieve our strategy, balance social, environmental and economic considerations and manage risk accordingly.

To ensure we achieve this growth in the right way, we place great emphasis on our values. We are committed to applying the highest standards throughout the company, everywhere we do business.

Diversity and inclusion is at the heart of our business. Joining HSBC will give you the opportunity to work in a collegiate and supportive environment in which we seek to develop and promote you based on merit.

We also have a strong commitment to sustainability and encourage employees to participate in our community projects and other activities.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Financial Operations Manager
jobs.descriptionText:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
Associate Director, Financial Operations Manager
.
Business: GCIO COO
Principal Responsibilities
Financial management
Manage ASP CTO financials including direct cost booking, recharge review , rate setting and recovery.
Ensure timely and accurate cost recognision, complete monthly Cadency reconciliations in line with accounting policy and adherence to operational risk control framework
Review direct cost monthly, perform variance analysis, and proactively raise insights, risks and corrective actions.
Provide clear executive summaries and management updates, supporting decision-making .
Partner with CTO leaders and business managers to provide commercial advice, using operational metrics to improve efficiency and outcomes.
Influence stakeholders to implement new policies/guidelines, using strong coordination, negotiation and judgement.
Stakeholder engagement (local customers & global teams)
Improve cost transparency and support customers with cost management while managing expectations.
Act as the primary Finance interface for China Technology stakeholders, partnering closely with global teams.
Coordinate across Finance, Procurement, Vendor Management and CTO teams to deliver end-to-end finance outcomes.
Translate finance requirements into practical actions for Technology teams, ensuring alignment to governance, timelines and deliverables.
Local regulatory & governance fulfilment (China)
Ensure finance operations meet local statutory/regulatory requirements, including audit readiness and documentation standards.
Maintain strong controls in Risk/Compliance to remediate issues on time.
Maintain evidence packs and governance artefacts to support audits, inspections and internal reviews.
Wider financial support to ASP markets
Play a key role in the China Finance Operations to ensure consistent service delivery across ASP markets.
Manage core workflows (e.g., accruals, forecasting, actual vs forecast) to ensure cost booking accuracy and timeliness.
Build team capability through standard work, documentation, training and continuous improvement.
Process simplification & continuous improvement
Identify pain points, duplication and manual activities across CTO Infrastructure finance processes.
Drive simplification, standardisation and automation (where feasible) to improve efficiency, strengthen controls and enhance transparency.
Requirements
Strong experience in technology/infrastructure cost management.
Demonstrable people leadership experience leading a team.
Effective stakeholder leadership and influence across CTO, Finance, Procurement, Vendor Management and global teams; able to translate finance requirements into practical delivery.
Solid command of controls, operational risk and China regulatory/governance.
Continuous improvement mindset—simplifies and standardises processes, AI and new tools adoption.
You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.
HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
***Issued By HSBC Software Development (GuangDong) Limited***
